title.narrative: Integrated Area-Based Support for Resilience in Tell Rifaat

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtBO proposes a comprehensive 12-month intervention in Tell Rifat that integrates General Protection (GP), Child Protection (CP), Gender-Based Violence (GBV), Mine Action (MA), Shelter, and Multi-Purpose Cash Assistance (MPCA) to address the interlinked needs of host and returnee populations. The focus is on women, girls, boys, persons with disabilities (PwDs), and other highly vulnerable groups. The centerpiece is an inclusive Community Center, serving as a safe, confidential hub for life-saving protection services and coordinated referrals to shelter, cash, and other essential services.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe GP component provides the overarching framework for risk identification, legal aid, HLP assistance, individual protection assistance, and the establishment of community-based protection committees. These committees, trained in safe identification and referrals, link directly to CP, GBV, and MA teams, ensuring that protection risks identified at the community level are referred to specialized services and to other sectors, such as shelter repairs for unsafe housing or MPCA for urgent economic needs.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtCP interventions are embedded within this GP framework, offering specialized child-centered case management, MHPSS, structured parenting programs, and recreational and resilience-building activities. CP teams work closely with GP actors to ensure that child-specific risks identified through community outreach or GBV case management are addressed holistically.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtGBV services—including survivor-centered case management, individual and group PSS, legal referrals, and empowerment activities—are fully integrated with GP and CP pathways. GP actors refer survivors or women and girls at risk to GBV specialists, while GBV caseworkers link cases requiring legal documentation to GP legal aid teams or unsafe housing repairs to the shelter sector. GBV risk mitigation is also mainstreamed in MPCA and shelter interventions, ensuring distribution sites, cash points, and construction activities are safe, inclusive, and accessible.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe MA component, covering EORE and victim assistance, is interwoven across GP, CP, and GBV activities. GP and CP caseworkers incorporate hazard mapping into individual case plans and refer individuals in contaminated areas to EORE sessions. GBV actors integrate EORE into women’s and girls’ empowerment sessions, recognizing their heightened risk when moving in contaminated areas. Victim assistance for EO survivors is managed through GP case management, with direct links to MPCA for income recovery and to shelter rehabilitation for adapting homes to disability-related needs. All MA activities are coordinated with the Mine Action Sub-Cluster and accredited operators to ensure technical accuracy and alignment with clearance priorities.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe MPCA component provides six rounds of unconditional $100 cash transfers to 300 highly vulnerable households identified through the Protection-focused Household Vulnerability Tool. All referrals originate from GP, CP, and GBV case management, ensuring that assistance targets households facing acute protection risks. MPCA is therefore both a stand-alone intervention and a cross-sectoral tool to address economic barriers in protection cases.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe Shelter component rehabilitates minor and moderately damaged houses and community infrastructure to improve safety, security, and living conditions. Protection assessments from GP, CP, and GBV teams directly inform shelter targeting, ensuring repairs benefit households where unsafe housing contributes to protection risks.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtComplementarity is achieved by building on current interventions in the same area, including a CBPF-funded MPCA project (375 HHs, Mar–Aug 2025) and a ShelterBox-funded shelter project (150 houses) and NEA (Protection). The proposed action expands coverage, layers services, and strengthens integrated referrals between sectors, while avoiding duplication through active participation in the Protection, GBV, CP, Shelter, Cash WG, and Mine Action Sub-Cluster.ltbrgtlt/pgt
